svg.title: Initial Configuration and Purpose of Quantum Teleportation
svg.desc: Alice holds an unknown general state |ψ⟩ and one qubit of an entangled Bell pair. Bob holds the other entangled Bell qubit and a target qubit initialized to |0⟩. Alice's purpose is to teleport |ψ⟩ to Bob's target qubit.
svg.text: Initial Setup: Preparing to Teleport an Unknown Qubit
Alice holds an unknown qubit and a shared Bell qubit; Bob holds the entangled partner and a target qubit in |0⟩.

g.text: Holds input state |ψ⟩ & Bell qubit A
Amplitudes α, β are completely unknown to Alice
STATE TO BE TELEPORTED TO BOB
Maximally entangled with Bob's Qubit B
1. Couples Qubit 1 and Qubit 2 with CNOT and Hadamard gates.
2. Measures both qubits, destroying local copy & yielding 2 bits (m, n).
Holds target qubit |0⟩ & Bell qubit B
Local destination particle ready to receive |ψ⟩
Remains maximally mixed until message arrives
1. Awaits 2 classical bits (m, n) from Alice over classical channel.
2. Applies Pauli correction Xⁿ then Zᵐ to restore exact state |ψ⟩.
